title: Keep answer-generated distinct from task-complete
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Producing an answer is not the same as finishing the task when verification is required. Accepts inspiration requirement 5[^insp-r05].
implementation: `OutcomeContract` in `mechaharness.outcome_contract` distinguishes `answer_generated`, `verified`, `complete`, and `failed`. `DefaultVerificationPolicy` selects the strongest sufficient oracle and gates completion through the outcome contract when `require_verification` is set.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
